facts.name: WideString
facts.meaning: u32 UTF-16 code-unit count followed by UTF-16LE units; no terminator

facts.name: DirectProperty
facts.meaning: When context write stream exists, property name is omitted and known typed value is written directly

facts.name: PrimitiveDispatch
facts.meaning: Native metadata type dispatch: 7 bool, 9 byte, 12 i32, 13 u32, 16 f32, 17 f64; vector types multiply element count

facts.name: MatrixAndBox
facts.meaning: SBox3 writes six f64; Box3 six f32; ADevMatrix writes sixteen f32 starting at native matrix+8

facts.name: SharedObject
facts.meaning: InterfaceID identifies serializer; serializers flagged unique write an object identity string produced by %p; already-seen identity suppresses body

facts.name: World
facts.meaning: InterfaceID, RevisionId:u32, PublishMode:i32, serialized children, WorldSerializerEndMark string; nested ARenderList adds Accelerate:bool, root IWorld dispatch does not

facts.name: RootVersions
facts.meaning: First group writes Size:u32, (InterfaceID:utf16,Version:u32)*Size, EnvironmentVersion:utf16 from IEnvironment::ActiveEnvironmentID

facts.name: GroupOverride
facts.meaning: Fusion replaces generic group framing, writes root versions once, conditional transforms/style/world, then quick NodeDataType branch

facts.name: QuickNode
facts.meaning: Quick base writes NodeType and AttributeType without class/handle; NodeData suffix includes numeric segment/entity links and typed presentation flags

facts.name: SimpleMeshOverride
facts.meaning: Fusion custom mesh omits generic RenderGeom VertexFormat link; writes Modelbox, PrimitiveType, inline vertex buffer, optional index serializer, Planarity

facts.name: VertexRange
facts.meaning: Three i32: stream number, byte offset, byte length; separate stream_mesh_%03d receives exactly byte length bytes

facts.name: IndexRange
facts.meaning: Four i32: stream number, byte offset, byte length, index stride equals 2; last flag selects u16 versus u32 indices

facts.name: VertexFields
facts.meaning: Field count followed by six i32 per native VertexField, member offsets +0x10 through +0x24

facts.name: VertexFieldConstructor
facts.meaning: Member order: type enum, usage enum, offset, stream index, usage index, instance control; stream initially bool(instance control>0), usage index=(usage>>8)&15

facts.name: StreamAndUsage
facts.meaning: StreamCount and ToSingle/ToMultiStream prove +0x1c stream index; IndexOf(usage,index) proves +0x20 usage index; Offset(usage) returns +0x18

facts.name: VertexMeaning
facts.meaning: Native Metal adapter converts type enum to MTL format; offset multiplied by four; stream member becomes bufferIndex; instance control>0 selects PerInstance, otherwise PerVertex; Metal step rate fixed 1

facts.name: RootWorldDispatch
facts.meaning: Root requests IWorld serializer, so ARenderList root omits derived Accelerate; nested ARenderList uses derived serializer

facts.name: EntityByteOrder
facts.meaning: EntityID constructed as eight explicitly shifted bytes, big-endian numeric order; not ordinary little-endian uint64 primitive

facts.name: EntityPredicates
facts.meaning: Entity status1 and2 carry segment/entity identity;0 omits it

facts.name: EmptyAttributeKinds
facts.meaning: Empty ordinary kind0 and empty extended kind1 omit attribute-set payload; populated2/3 select ordinary/extended

facts.name: QuickNodeSelectors
facts.meaning: Selectors2/3/5/6/7 share NodeData quick payload;4 adds IsXRef, conditional ACTEntityID bytes, InstanceIDu32

facts.name: BrepWorld
facts.meaning: ValidBody flag, edge quickgroup and LOD vector, face quickgroup and LOD vector, optional double-precision modelbox

facts.name: SketchWorld
facts.meaning: Optional faces BRep world, signed LOD and regular node counts, LOD nodes, regular nodes and nonculling nodes

facts.name: TextureMappingCache
facts.meaning: Layered flag, primary cache, optional secondary cache; each modei32,axis3d,box6d,baked16d,mapping16d;mode4 adds cylinder-cap booleans,mode6 adds wood-origin and board-face-axis3d

limits: Instance control complete portable integer semantics beyond the tested zero profile unresolved; Metal uses only its sign
Native property names are not persisted; static call extraction includes branches and cannot itself establish linear layout
Only the two documented profiles are completely qualified; other native callbacks remain unsupported. Native complete-document acceptance is recorded separately in LocalOracle/NativeDocuments
